security_implications: This chunk implements the debug policy register with write access control gated by a Mubi4 VALID register. If the not_valid check fails (e.g., due to a corrupted Mubi4 value), the debug policy could be written after it should have been locked, allowing an attacker to change the debug category and gain unauthorized debug access, exposing secrets and system state. Furthermore, the shadow register integrity errors (policy_shadowed_update_err/storage_err) are forwarded but not locally handled; if ignored, a corrupted debug policy could persist undetected, weakening the security posture. The BUS.INTEGRITY errors from the core and JTAG register blocks are also output and require appropriate system-level response.
